node.title: DSP8 primitive cubic shift-pair adapter
node.statement: Every ordered DSP8 disjoint edge gives a decorated pair of monic H-split cubics A,B with A-B=t(s-r)X and A(0)=B(0)=-rs. This is a reduced degree-three/depth-one shift pair. Since n is dyadic, gcd(n,3)=1 makes every such pair coefficient-primitive. The converse reconstruction is exact, and the orientation ledger is J_25^c=4K_25^c=8D_6,25^c. The former sufficient target becomes 10K_25^0+17K_25^A<=223n^2; the later antipodal quotient-mass payment weakens the live target without changing this adapter.
